shared_elements: possible standing human figures (eroded relief figures in A; stick-figure anthropomorphs in B)
justification: The only possible correspondence is that both surfaces may include upright human figures — worn, rounded relief figures set in a recessed niche in A, versus flat stick-figure anthropomorphs among boats in B — which is far too generic to indicate any shared iconography. B presents a dense scene of schematic boats with hull, upcurved prows and rows of crew strokes plus a figure with raised arms, none of which has any counterpart in A, whose visible content is an architectural rock-cut face with sculptural, three-dimensional forms rather than linear figural drawing.
